_comment: Watch file for one heartbeat automation, saved as ~/.codex/ateles/turn_guard/heartbeats/<automation id>.json. The Ateles codex_turn_guard hashes each command's output; once the heartbeat path is enforced, an idle run is skipped only while every hash and the repository are unchanged. argv is run without a shell, read-only, 6 s each and 12 s in total. base_s and cap_s set the back-off window after a quiet run (it doubles per consecutive quiet run, up to cap_s). An automation without this file is never skipped.
